name: Lingua Naija
description: Gamified Nigerian language learning app with lessons across 10 languages (Igbo, Yorùbá, Hausa, Edo, Efịk, Urhobo, Tiv, Uvwie, Isoko, and Ijaw), voice audio, AI tutor conversation partner with Gemini, in-lesson linguistic breakdowns, culture hub, and Ebbinghaus spaced repetition memory engine.
